author: Microsoft
name: Comet Node-Backend App
description: A single-project Comet app rendered natively by the node backend (Jetpack Compose on Android, SwiftUI on iOS) — no MAUI in the render path.

applicationId.description: Overrides the app id ($(ApplicationId) on Android, CFBundleIdentifier on iOS).

cometRoot.description: MSBuild path to the Comet repo's src/Comet directory (the node backend is not yet published as a package). Defaults to '..\..', which resolves when the app is created under src/Comet/sample/<name>/.
